Whether that consent is VERIFIABLE is a separate gate, governed by contact_gates.consent.require_provenance in the ruleset. With the fixture's bare boolean and no disclosure text, hash, URL, timestamp, IP, user agent or seller chain, enabling that gate takes this population to zero.
